lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby and Tina are walking home.

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Our city is clean and beautiful. I like living here.
lines.chinese: 我们的城市干净又美丽。我喜欢住在这里。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Me too!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby throws a banana skin on the ground.
lines.chinese: Bobby把一块香蕉皮扔在地上。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Bobby, you shouldn't do that! It makes the street dirty.
lines.chinese: Bobby，你不应该那样做！这会把街道弄脏。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'm sorry. I'll pick it up.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我会把它捡起来。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: But it is too late. Billy falls down.

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: Ouch!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby tries to help Billy up. Tina cleans the street.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Are you OK, Billy?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'm sorry, Billy. Tina and I will walk you home.
lines.chinese: 对不起，Billy。Tina和我会陪你走回家。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Billy's mum is happy to see them.
lines.chinese: Billy的妈妈很高兴见到他们。

lines.speaker: Billy's mum
lines.english: Have some bananas, children.

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: Oh no ...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The girl in a T-shirt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Cleaned the dirty street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It made her tired and thirsty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: But the street was clean and neat.
lines.chinese: 但街道变得干净又整洁。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: What's your plan for the weekend, Su Hai?
lines.chinese: Su Hai，你周末有什么计划？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: I'll go plogging with my family.
lines.chinese: 我会和家人一起慢跑捡垃圾。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: Plogging? What's that?

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: It's jogging and picking up rubbish at the same time. It can keep us healthy and make our city clean!
lines.chinese: 就是一边慢跑一边捡垃圾。它能让我们保持健康，也让城市干净！

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: That sounds great! Can I join you?
lines.chinese: 听起来很棒！我可以加入你们吗？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Sure! We'll go plogging in the park this Saturday morning. Let's meet at the school gate at nine o'clock.
lines.chinese: 当然！这周六上午我们会去公园慢跑捡垃圾。我们九点在校门口见吧。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: OK. I'll be here on time.

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: See you then.

lines.speaker: Su Hai & Su Yang
lines.english: Good morning!

lines.speaker: Other students
lines.english: Good morning!

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Nice to see all of you!

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We all want to go plogging!
lines.chinese: 我们都想去慢跑捡垃圾！

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: It's fun. You'll like it.
lines.chinese: 这很有趣。你们会喜欢的。

lines.speaker: Su Yang
lines.english: Here are the rubbish bags.

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Look at all this rubbish!

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We did a great job!

lines.speaker: Yang Ling
lines.english: Let's go plogging again next weekend!
lines.chinese: 下周末我们再去慢跑捡垃圾吧！

lines.speaker: Others
lines.english: All right!
